title: Supplement to Oak Ridge National Laboratory’s Analysis of a Metallic Specimen
doc_notes: This document is an AARO supplement to an Oak Ridge National Laboratory analysis of a metallic specimen, concluding the material is terrestrial and likely related to historical magnesium alloy research.

incidents.summary: Analysis of a magnesium alloy specimen alleged to be a component recovered from a 1947 crashed extraterrestrial vehicle.
incidents.explanation: The specimen is terrestrial in origin and consistent with mid-20th century magnesium alloy research and development.
